decisions.reason: 'Nhà hát LIVE' preserves the LIVE theater meaning and is natural Vietnamese UI wording.
'Vật phẩm' is the standard concise Vietnamese label for 物品.
'Album' is a natural borrowed Vietnamese UI label and matches 相册 in this menu context.
奖杯陈列室 denotes a trophy display room/gallery; 'Tủ cúp' narrows it to a cabinet and loses the room meaning.

历代评价点 contains a historical/all-generations qualifier that 'Điểm thành tích' does not express, but embedded context does not establish the exact in-game metric label strongly enough for a safe replacement.
'Tùy chọn' accurately and naturally translates the menu label 选项.
Meaning and two-line structure are preserved: the user can review special memories.
'Hỗ trợ' is the natural concise UI translation of 支持 in this settings/help menu context.
FAQ is an established interface acronym and should remain unchanged.
'Trở về màn hình tiêu đề' fully preserves 返回标题画面 and is natural Vietnamese UI wording.
'Âm thanh' accurately translates 声音 as a settings label.
The FAQ explanation preserves both the purpose and browser-opening notice, including the newline structure.
'Cài đặt điều kiện' directly and naturally represents 条件设定.
'Âm lượng' is the exact natural settings label for 音量.
'Nhạc LIVE' naturally conveys LIVE乐曲 as LIVE music/song content.

decisions.proposed_text: Giới tính người tường thuật・bình luận
decisions.reason: 实况・解说的性别 refers to the gender of the people providing play-by-play/commentary; the current wording can read as if the narration itself has a gender.

decisions.proposed_text: Cài giới tính người tường thuật・bình luận
decisions.reason: The source explicitly sets the gender of the play-by-play/commentary voices; adding 'người' restores that human referent clearly.
'Nam' exactly and naturally translates 男性 in this gender selector.
'Nữ' exactly and naturally translates 女性 in this gender selector.
'Ngẫu nhiên' is the correct natural selector label for 随机.
